title: 菊花賞の後に・次に背中を見せるのは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week triumphs over Seiun Sky in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Seiun Sky is thirsty for revenge and challenges Special Week to a rematch, spurring her to shift her focus toward the spring Tenno Sho.
